{{Top|fa}} {{Character |type=CIS |image=[[File:WhormLoathsomHS.png]] |name=Whorm Loathsom |homeworld=[[Kerkoidia/Legends|Kerkoidia]]''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]'' |birth= |death= |species=[[Kerkoiden/Legends|Kerkoiden]] |gender=[[Gender/Legends|Male]]''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]'' |pronouns=He/him |height=1.75 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes=[[Color/Legends|Red]][[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] |skin=Bluish gray |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]'' **[[Kerkoidia planetary forces]] *[[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] *[[Retail Caucus/Legends|Retail Caucus]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|Unless you call off your troops right now, I will have no choice but to destroy you.|Whorm Loathsom, to Obi-Wan Kenobi|audio=CallOffYourTroops-TCWf.flac|}} '''Whorm Loathsom''' was a [[Kerkoiden/Legends|Kerkoiden]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who [[Homeworld/Legends|hailed]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kerkoidia/Legends|Kerkoidia]] and served both in his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld's]] [[Kerkoidia planetary forces|planetary forces]] and as the [[General/Legends|general]] of the [[Retail Caucus/Legends|Retail Caucus's]] military forces in the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. An accomplished commander, his numerous victories during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] led him to infamy throughout the [[Southern Core|Inner Core]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Loathsom captured the planet [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]], and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] dispatched [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-led [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] forces to [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|liberate]] the planet. After being forced to retreat, Loathsom launched a counterattack, advancing his [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[Troop/Legends|troops]] behind a [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] that rendered the Republic's [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] useless. [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] pretended to surrender to the Kerkoiden in order to gain time for [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], to eliminate the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]]. Loathsom eventually lost patience with discussing Kenobi's terms of surrender and threatened to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the Jedi. After Skywalker and Tano destroyed the generator, however, Loathsom himself was captured. With his shameful defeat and capture on Christophsis, Loathsom was taken to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where he was tried by the Republic and found guilty of [[Treason/Legends|treason]], as his service in his Republic-aligned homeworld's planetary forces made him a member of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]]. As of [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], he was still incarcerated within the [[Republic military base]]'s high-level [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on Coruscant. ==Biography== ===Capturing Christophsis=== {{Quote|You are no longer in the Republic. You are no longer beholden to their laws. Yer world's resources will be transferred to the Confederacy. We wage this war for yer independence. Do not resist our efforts. Remain vigilant for Republic reprisals.|Whorm Loathsom, to the population of Christophsis|''[[The Clone Wars: Shadowed]]''}} [[File:LoathsomMonitor-TCWWC16p01.png|thumb|left|250px|Loathsom speaks to the population of Christophsis.]] The [[Kerkoiden/Legends|Kerkoiden]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Whorm Loathsom came [[Homeworld/Legends|from]] the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kerkoidia/Legends|Kerkoidia]] and served in his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld's]] [[Kerkoidia planetary forces|planetary forces]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] as the [[General/Legends|general]] of the [[Retail Caucus/Legends|Retail Caucus's]] military forces and a leader within the Retail Caucus itself.{{CSWECite|II|212|Kerkoiden}} His creative strategies won many victories for the Confederacy, including a string of military campaigns, leading him to become considered a legend throughout the [[Southern Core]][[Jason Fry]]'s comments in {{Blog|danwallace|143|Endnotes for Star Wars: The Essential Atlas (part 1 of 5)}} have clarified that the "Inner Core," as referenced in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]], is an alternate name for the [[Southern Core]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. and winning himself the respect of Republic strategists based on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. He proved his bravery while battling the Republic''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Heroes and Villains Flip Book]]'' and was even seen by some as a hero on the Separatist side.{{InsiderCite|109|Ask Lobot}} In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], in the seventh [[Standard week/Legends|week]] of the war,''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]''''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' the Confederacy set its sights on capturing the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planet [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]]. Loathsom's forces invaded the [[Crystal/Legends|crystalline]] world and, via a massive planet-wide [[Hologram/Legends|holotransmission]], Loathsom told the planet's [[Christophsian/Legends|Christophsian]] inhabitants to submit to Separatist rule. As the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] dispatched a contingent of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]—under the command of [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]—to [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|liberate]] Christophsis,{{TCW|The Hidden Enemy}} the [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] arrived on the planet and met with Loathsom. Ventress relayed intelligence to Loathsom on the Republic's plan to ambush the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] from a [[Christophsis double-towered building/Legends|double-towered business center]], which had been collected and transmitted by her [[Spy/Legends|spy]], [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[Slick/Legends|Slick]]. Loathsom and Ventress used Slick's information to prepare an ambush against the Republic. Shortly thereafter, Skywalker and Kenobi went to the [[Christophsis Separatist headquarters/Legends|Confederacy base]] to conduct an investigation behind enemy lines. After [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|engaging]] the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]] and forcing them to flee, Ventress relayed further orders to Loathsom through a [[Unidentified T-series tactical droid (Christophsis)/Legends|tactical droid]], telling Loathsom to delay the Jedi as long as possible while she left to execute a mission for her [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]], [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. ===Battling the Republic=== {{Quote|Why are we stopping?''"
"''We cannot get past their cannons, sir.''"
"''''Cannons?'' This will never do. We must pull back and set up our deflector shields.|Whorm Loathsom and a B1 battle droid|audio=ThisWillNeverDo-TCWf.flac|}} With an [[Army/Legends|army]] of greater size than the Republic had expected, Loathsom launched an assault on the Jedi and their [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] forces. As the Republic established a base in{{TCWA|Republic Defender}} the planet's capital,''[[Shadow Games]]'' [[Chaleydonia/Legends|Crystal City]], Loathsom set out to destroy the Republic's command center with his battle [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Troop/Legends|troops]] before the base could be completed. Loathsom deployed his forces at the Republic's landing zone, but after his [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]], [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]], droid-[[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|Single Trooper Aerial Platforms]], and [[NR-N99 Persuader-class droid enforcer/Legends|NR-N99 ''Persuader''-class tanks]] did not succeed in breaching the Republic defenses, he sent more powerful [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]] and [[OG-9 homing spider droid/Legends|OG-9 homing spider droids]] to cut through the Republic's tower-mounted turret emplacements. When that, too, failed, he targeted a Republic [[Refugee/Legends|refugee]] camp and besieged it with his forces just as the Republic was setting up a defense of the camp. Despite deploying [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] and moving his ground troops forward under the protection of mobile [[super tank shield generator]]s, Loathsom was unable to destroy the refugee camp, but he did not relent in his campaign for Christophsis. With his army spread thin over the world, Loathsom dispatched his battle droids in two groups to meet up at a rendezvous point on the planet. When his two battle groups were ambushed by Republic forces, Loathsom pressed his attack and sent forward several large [[Octuptarra magna tri-droid/Legends|octuptarra magna tri-droids]].''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]'' However, his forces were defeated by [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]] thanks to covering fire from the Republic [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Dauntless (Venator-class)|''Dauntless'']]. After several days of fighting, the Kerkoiden was forced to retreat.[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]] [[File:Loathsome_Christophsis.png|thumb|right|250px|Loathsom leads his army on Christophsis.]] Loathsom soon returned to attack the Republic's base in Crystal [[City/Legends|City]], advancing B1, [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2]], and tri-droids in the front lines while he followed behind with a group of [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]]. However, the Republic's [[AV-7 Antivehicle Cannon/Legends|AV-7 Antivehicle Cannons]] forced the Confederate [[Tank/Legends|tanks]] to halt their progress. Learning of the enemy's [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]], Loathsom had an OOM command battle droid turn the troops around, and after his forces had pulled back, he set up a [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] in preparation for another attack on the Republic army. He then dispatched his forces in two groups from the south and the east to beleaguer Crystal City. Kenobi and [[Alpha Squad (Galactic Republic)|Alpha Squad]] halted the south force's approach, but [[Bravo Squad (Galactic Republic)|Bravo Squad]] was unable to stop the east force's advance. Loathsom then led his east battle group and advanced behind his expanding deflector shield, which effectively negated the Republic's long-ranged artillery.''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]'' [[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] edition Loathsom sent his battle droids to destroy the Republic's [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]] while he followed with lines of droid tanks. Because of the Confederacy's deflector shield, the Republic troops were unable to stop the advancing droids, and Kenobi had his troops protect the cannons while he gained time by stalling Loathsom. The Kerkoiden general cornered Kenobi with his Armored Assault Tank and a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of super battle droids and [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|DSD1 dwarf spider droids]]. Kenobi pretended to surrender to Loathsom, [[Telekinesis/Legends|forming]] some crystal rubble into a table with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], and the two seated themselves to discuss the terms of Kenobi's "surrender." Over a cup of [[Tarine tea/Legends|tarine tea]], brought by Loathsom's [[LEP servant droid/Legends|LEP servant droid]], [[LEP-96M3]], the discussion of Kenobi's surrender continued, during which Loathsom became increasingly impatient with Kenobi as he finally realized that Kenobi was stalling. Overturning the crystal table, Loathsom ordered his troops to seize the Jedi, demanding his surrender and threatening to [[Death/Legends|kill]] him. At that moment, however, Skywalker and his recently apprenticed [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], destroyed the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]], causing the shield to recede and expose Loathsom's troops to long-range artillery. Kenobi broke free of the battle droids and captured Loathsom in a headlock. As the battle droids began to fire on Kenobi, LEP-96M3 was destroyed, and the Kerkoiden ordered his droid squad to stand down. With its renewed artillery usage, the Republic was able to defeat the Confederate forces, and Loathsom was taken [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]], bound in [[Binders/Legends|handcuffs]]. Republic reinforcements arrived on Christophsis, and Loathsom was shamed with his defeat in a battle that would have been a sure Separatist victory.{{CSWECite|II|258|Loathsom, General Whorm}} ===In custody=== Following his capture, Loathsom was taken to Coruscant, where he was tried and swiftly found guilty of treason, as Kerkoidia was still recognized as a member of the Republic, making him a member of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] for his service in his homeworld's planetary forces. After being interrogated by [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] and having all useful information extracted from him, Loathsom was sent to solitary confinement, eventually ending up in the high-level [[Prison/Legends|prison]] of the [[Republic military base]].{{TCW|The Jedi Who Knew Too Much}} As of circa [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after his capture,''[[Star Wars: Darth Maul — Death Sentence]]'' Loathsom was still serving out a sentence in the prison alongside other captured Separatist comrades, including [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]] and [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]]. The clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] of the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] who oversaw prison security kept him under close surveillance in his solitary cell. Loathsom remained in Republic custody through [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the final year of the Clone Wars, when the Republic [[Declaration of a New Order|became]] the first [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].{{FactFile2014|26|LOA 1-4|Whorm Loathsom}} ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|'Tis a rare honor to be able to meet one's opponent face to face. You're a legend throughout the Inner Core.''"
"''Thank you. The honor is all mine. I'm so ''glad'' you decided to surrender.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Whorm Loathsom|audio=RareHonor-TCWf.flac|}} [[File:Loathsom_surrender.png|thumb|left|250px|Loathsom was shamed by his defeat and capture at the hands of Kenobi.]] Gruff and guttural, Whorm Loathsom was a cunning and accomplished commander who served the Confederacy of Independent Systems, proving his bravery in battle with the Republic on numerous counts. His strategies in battle led the Separatists to numerous victories, and he prided himself on his leadership skills. He saw nobility to war and believed that opponents should respect each other instead of behaving like savages, sometimes dismissing the losses to clone troopers and his own battle droids as expendable. Hailed as a hero by some on the Separatist side, Loathsom had faith in the Confederacy's causes, telling the people of Christophsis to submit to Confederate rule once his forces seized the world. He recognized the merits of a strategic retreat; when he realized that his droids would be useless against the Republic's heavy cannons on Christophsis, he ordered his forces to retreat and set up a deflector shield. However, he often overestimated his abilities as a Separatist leader. He was considered a legend throughout the Inner Core, but his supreme vanity and ego sometimes got in the way of his role as a general, resulting in orders and decisions formed more out of arrogance than of strategy. Notorious for being equally cruel and vain,[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (junior novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' junior novelization]] Loathsom was not impervious to flattery, as evidenced by his reactions to Obi-Wan Kenobi's comments on his abilities, and his overly prominent ego, as well as his good manners, allowed Kenobi to stall him while Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano destroyed the shield generator. Loathsom loathed the fact that some did not afford Kerkoidens the respect that they deserved and was influenced by remarks on his species, rising to the bait and civilly discussing Kenobi's surrender when the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] implied that Kerkoidens were less civilized than Humans. His eagerness to teach the Republic a lesson or two sometimes caused his comments to lack respect when addressing associates such as Asajj Ventress. When Loathsom finally realized that Kenobi was stalling for time, he acted on his anger and overturned the crystal table where they were seated. He was quick in attempting to force Kenobi to surrender, but was later shamed after he was defeated and captured. Loathsom formed an attachment to his LEP servant droid, LEP-96M3, who had learned to perform his duties exactly as the Kerkoiden liked. He was subsequently saddened when the droid was destroyed on Christophsis, missing his servant considerably. Standing 1.75 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall, Loathsom had [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and bluish gray skin. He was able to speak both [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] and [[Kerkoidese]]. ==Equipment== In battle, Whorm Loathsom wore the ceremonial uniform of a [[Kerkoiden cavalier]] and a [[fauld]] in honor of his victories during the war. ==Behind the scenes== ===Notable appearances=== [[File:Loathsom_Neimoidian_art.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Concept art for a Neimoidian, upon which Loathsom was based]] The character of Whorm Loathsom was created for the [[2008]] [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]], which served as an introduction to the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|television series]] of the same name. First mentioned in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|film's novelization]] and the reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]'',''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]'' Loathsom made his debut in the film's [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (junior novelization)|junior novelization]], which was written by [[Tracey West]]. In the film, Loathsom was voiced by [[Corey Burton]], who also provided the voice for [[Count/Legends|Count]] Dooku and [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]]. Burton voiced Loathsom with a [[Wikipedia:Scottish Gaelic language|Scottish]] accent,{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20090320.html|text=Corey Burton: Voicing Villains}} which was evidenced further in "Shadowed," with the accent being put into text and expressions. The Kerkoiden was based on concept art for a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] that was drawn by [[Doug Chiang]] during production for [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. In [[2011]], Loathsom was featured in the non-canonical [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]''. Loathsom appears in the "Republic Assault" mission set on Christophsis, which involves the Confederacy and the Republic fighting for control of Crystal City. Completing the mission results in Loathsom being locked in the brig of the ''Venator''-class [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']], which acts as the in-game Republic hub. By using the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Robonino/Legends|Robonino]], it is possible to release him from his cell, making Loathsom available for purchase and later use in the Free Play mode of the game.''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]'' ===Fate after Christophsis=== In [[February]] [[2013]], Loathsom made a brief appearance in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth season]] episode "[[The Jedi Who Knew Too Much]]," on a security camera screen as one of the prisoners in the Republic military base. His inclusion in the episode conflicted with information established in ''The Official Guide: Season 1'', which stated that he had eventually escaped from Republic custody. The episode's [http://starwars.com/explore/the-clone-wars/ep518/#!/about online guide] on [[StarWars.com]] referred to his capture during the events of ''The Clone Wars'' film,{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/the-jedi-who-knew-too-much-episode-guide|text="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}} while [[Holocron continuity database]] manager [[Leland Chee]] also noted that he was "still" in prison.{{Twitter|HolocronKeeper|status/303206438166224896|[[Leland Chee]]|quote=For those keeping track: Wat Tambor, Poggle the Lesser, General Whorm Loathsom - still in prison|archivefile=File:Chee-PrisonersTCWS5.png}} This article therefore assumes that the details regarding his escape have been overridden in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]]. The following details the original information from ''The Official Episode Guide: Season 1''. After being tried and found guilty, Loathsom is transferred to solitary confinement on the prison world of [[Akrit'tar/Legends|Akrit'tar]]. He eventually trades his prison cell for house arrest in a rustic but still elegant [[Whorm Loathsom's Kerkoidia castle|castle]] in the outbacks of Kerkoidia. Weeks after the transfer, Loathsom's castle is raided by Separatist operatives, and he is spirited away from Republic captivity. [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.9|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic'' 6.9]] implies that he returns to Separatist service, as he is said to be massing a new Confederate [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in the [[Metellos system/Legends|Metellos system]], but the magazine does not indicate a specific timeline for those events.[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.9|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Comic 6.9]]
